part2-decision-not-ping.label: Illustrative policy for one website article in one workspace. Hold the release while evidence is missing: the current owner remains responsible until a worker accepts the task. Queue the exact preview, source check and editorial review for a decision. Interrupt only if waiting risks a deadline or makes a serious problem worse; silence is not approval. After an approved release, compare the live page with the approved version. Log a receipt only if they match; mismatch is not success. Measure human attention per finished job, including attention spent on unfinished work.
part2-decision-not-ping.caption: A blog release example, not a run log. Missing evidence holds release, a ready decision goes to the queue, and a verified match gets a quiet receipt.
